tbesh_html:
1) to subside, abate, decrease
1a) (Qal) to abate
1b) (Hiphil) to allay

strongs_1890.strongs_def: to weave (i.e. lay) a trap; figuratively, (through the idea of secreting) to allay (passions; physically, abate a flood)
strongs_1890.kjv_def: appease, assuage, make to cease, pacify, set.
